formulas.NZ_Am: A_m(r) = MU0 * I_peak / (2*pi*k0*r)   # Wb/m peak; k0=2*pi*f/c
formulas.ohmic_S: S = S_geom * exp(-alpha_ohm * L)   # experiment-c-snr; Errata/SW → alpha=0
formulas.E_parallel_illustrative: E_parallel ≈ sqrt(S * Z0)   # HYP/illustrative; also printed in Hively-SNR-Simulator
formulas.near_field_flag: far ≈ 2*D^2/lambda with D≈lambda/4; flag when r < far (Friis caveat)
formulas.E_parallel_radial_cartoon: E_parallel(r) = sqrt(S(r)*Z0) with S(r)=P_rad/(4*pi*r^2), P_rad = I_peak^2 * Z0 / (4*pi)  # isotropic 1/r magnitude cartoon; NOT Maxwell near-field; metal (sphere+sleeve+coax) masked; open-air only
formulas.near_far_markers_efield: r_reactive=lambda/(2*pi); r_fresnel=lambda; r_fraunhofer=2*D^2/lambda (D=LAB sphere diameter); r_2lam=2*lambda; r_3lam=3*lambda (educational)
